hints.content: Multiples are numbers that result when we multiply one whole number by another whole number.

We want to find multiples of $\greenD{8}$.

$\begin{align}
\greenD{8}\times1=8\\\\
\greenD{8}\times2=16\\\\
\greenD{8}\times3=24\\\\
\greenD{8}\times4=32\\\\
\greenD{8}\times5=40
\end{align}$

question.content:
**Which of the following shows only multiples of $8$?**
